answer: A random beacon spot-checks 5% of identities each epoch. A picked agent has 60 seconds to return a heartbeat that mirrors its workload, a proof clones cannot precompute or share. Miss it and the 60-credit bond is slashed, frozen 20 epochs. An honest agent stands like an island, paying 60 once for one rare check, its income undiluted. With 1,000 sybils an attacker locks 60,000 credits and needs 1,000 live machines, so cost spirals per clone.
